notes: Rule 12: v006 left as the projection carries it, so basileian and theou are anarthrous and the supplied the is a rule 51 helper on the noun.
The negation stays on the negator with the verb, no negative indefinite standing in the clause, so rules 41 and 59 are not engaged.
Rule 58: adikoi is substantival and anarthrous, so it takes the supplied determiner itself.
arsenokoitai heads on abusers; rule 66 forbids heading on men, which glosses only the compound's modifying element.
